title: Historically Accurate
description: A mod adding several historically accurate medieval features to the game based on life between 476AD and 1600AD.
body:
## What does this mod add?
**Historically Accurate** features a variety of additions based on real history. Currently, the mod is in early development, with the only released version being a test run. I am currently working on a 26.2 version of the mod with more features than the current release.

The mod's current version adds:

Food - Porridge, Oats (crafted from wheat), Tomatoes (with crop/seeds)

Tools/Weapons - Copper and Steel Pickaxes, Axes, Shovels, Hoes, and Falchions

Steel - Crafting process with in-world interactions

Zinc - Its ore, "Sphalerite", in three different qualities (Poor, Medium, Rich)

## Planned features
Future **26.1.2** versions will feature:
- Brass (tools) and its crafting processes (featuring more in-world interactions)
- Further early-game tech development (more flint tools, etc.)
- Backpacks (with hotkey)
- Expanded food/cooking/farming systems

## Want to help?
If you would like to provide artwork or just suggestions, feel free to join my Discord server (link to the right)! Or if you want to, you can donate to my Ko-Fi!

## Discord
If you want to see sneak-peeks or interact with a growing community, join my Discord!
